# Changelog — qa-gate-vercel

All notable changes to this skill will be documented in this file.

## [1.0.0] — 2025-02-25

### Added
- Initial release
- Pre-production validation for Vercel/Supabase/Firebase stack
- Test plan generation
- API endpoint validation
- UI/component validation
- Toast and notification testing
- Auth flow validation
- LLM quality evaluation (optional)
- Go/no-go report generation

{
  "name": "qa-gate-vercel",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Pre-production validation gate for Vercel/Supabase/Firebase stack — generates test plans, executes test suites, validates APIs, UI, toasts, LLM output quality, and produces go/no-go reports",
  "author": "guifav",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/guifav/openclaw-skills",
  "license": "MIT",
  "permissions": ["filesystem", "network"],
  "models": ["claude-*"],
  "tags": [
    "qa",
    "testing",
    "validation",
    "pre-production",
    "go-no-go",
    "vercel",
    "supabase",
    "firebase",
    "api-testing",
    "e2e",
    "llm-evaluation",
    "toast",
    "ui-testing"
  ],
  "minOpenClawVersion": "0.5.0",
  "entry": "SKILL.md",
  "skillDependencies": {
    "requires": ["stack-scaffold"],
    "recommended": ["test-sentinel"]
  },
  "openclaw": {
    "requires": {
      "bins": ["node", "npx", "git"],
      "env": [
        "OPENROUTER_API_KEY",
        "SUPABASE_URL",
        "SUPABASE_ANON_KEY",
        "VERCEL_TOKEN"
      ]
    },
    "primaryEnv": "VERCEL_TOKEN",
    "emoji": "🚦",
    "os": ["darwin", "linux", "win32"]
  }
}
